flags.why: The religious use illustrated here remains current and is not archaic, as in contemporary [Christian usage](https://wol.jw.org/vi/wol/d/r47/lp-vt/1101978112).
Hai người means two people and does not specify that they are men.
flags.fix: The two people shook hands and said goodbye.

flags.why: This pronoun is regional Central and Southern usage, as shown in the [Vietnamese pronoun comparison](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vietnamese_language).
flags.fix: Add Central and Southern tags; retain informal.

flags.why: The Vietnamese describes this crab's current size, not how large it grows.
flags.fix: This crab is only this big.

flags.why: The old meaning applies to a left hand or foot, rather than a window's location, according to the [dictionary definition](https://www.rung.vn/dict/vn_vn/Chi%C3%AAu).
flags.fix: Chân đăm đá chân chiêu. = The right foot knocks against the left foot.

flags.why: The common noun use meaning an election, as in cuộc bầu cử, is missing.
flags.fix: noun | election; ex: Cuộc bầu cử sẽ diễn ra vào tháng sau. = The election will take place next month.
